conclusion.reason: NEITHER method PyJHora offers can resolve the H-02 defect's own scale (0.0001 arcsec): its search-based ingress detection converges reliably only at 0.001 degrees and coarser (already ~36x looser than H-02's own scale) and diverges/fails at 0.0001 degrees (still ~4 more orders of magnitude too loose to reach); its direct longitude evaluation carries a ~20.6 arcsec systematic bias against this engine's certified ephemeris - about 205697x larger than the defect being investigated. This is recorded as a genuine limitation, not manufactured agreement: PyJHora cannot serve as a reliable Option B oracle for H-02 at its own required precision, by either method tested.
